assessments.reasoning: The Basics definitions make a value a sequence of ordered items, identify a singleton with its item, and exclude nested sequences. The maps-and-arrays clause separately permits an array as one item in a sequence.

challenge.method: Try to turn concatenation of an atomic value, a two-item sequence and the empty sequence into three nested values. Compare the flattening rule with a sequence whose single item is an array.
challenge.results: Sequence composition flattens intermediate sequences and drops empty contributions. An array is a single item even if its members are sequences, so the sequence non-nesting rule does not exclude an array item.

limitations: The source is the exact acquired W3C edition identified by the evidence record. The observed 2021 metadata notice and independently inspected linked context do not supply a different normative edition.
The inference is about the abstract XDM value. No memory representation, serialization or flattening of array members is concluded.
